notes: FINDING 1 (UNRESOLVED, two possible outcomes) — Delete Beneficiaries: Merge Join (DTSX 85205) has JoinType=1 (LEFT outer); the file rows (Sort 2, ExistsInFile = literal 1) feed the input NAMED "Merge Join Left Input" and CRM beneficiaries the one named "Right", but the <input> elements are serialized Right-then-Left (DTSX 85213/85222; the only Merge Join of 10 with this order). (a) If SSIS takes "left" by name → ExistsInFile is never NULL and nothing is ever deleted. (b) If it takes "left" by position → every active CRM beneficiary without a matching valid file row (Is Valid  Beneficiary DTSX 85144) is deleted on each run. Not provable from the DTSX — confirm in SSDT or from production counters (Row Deleted Count / ETL process counters).

Create Contact link: possible duplicate gen_contactlink rows in the same run — Aggregate groups on 17 columns and nothing de-duplicates (parent, child, customer account) before the full-cache 'Is ContactLink Exists' lookup.

Create Warning Note: Aggregate (DTSX 69294) also groups on FinanceNumber_11 and Account_Owner_Id_8, which are unused downstream → file rows differing only in those fields create duplicate warning notes in one run.

FINDING 2 — new parent contacts are never linked in the same run: 'Check If Contact Is Duplicate' sends only the first row per parent ID to NeedToCreate, drops later duplicates (no DirectRowTo) and sends only NULL-ID rows to NotNeedToCreate; IDs are never NULL after 'Add 0' padding, so the inner Merge Join (Sort ⋈ created contacts on gen_Parentidentitynumber_9) gets no left rows. Create Contact link / Update ContactLink therefore only receive parents that already existed in CRM (is Parent Exist match); a link for a newly created parent appears only in a later run — and 'Disabled contactlink' then sets gen_status = 2 on links not re-confirmed.

FINDING 3 — Update Contact writes the CHILD's identification type onto the PARENT: Param_11 gen_identificationtype comes from lookup 'Is Child Exists' (child contact) and is replaced by Type_20 only when the child's value is NULL (compare befor update main.cs:154-158; the "== 10" alternative is unreachable).

Update Employee MobilePhone: when the composed phone is empty and CRM has a phone, the CRM phone is cleared; modifiedon is written with DateTime.Now (local) into Gen_customeraccountBase (UTC column). Phone = Division_60 (prefix) + Workplace_59 (number) for Subject_12 == "11" rows; staging aliases Phone_Prefix/Phone_Number proven by externalMetadataColumnId (DTSX 103106-103107).
